packageRules.description: Dokładnie tag :latest — nie śledź. Uses matchCurrentValue (not matchCurrentVersion): 'latest' is a non-semver raw string tag, not a version range. matchCurrentValue compares the raw version/tag string directly; matchCurrentVersion only works with semver ranges and cannot match raw strings like 'latest'. Config migration per Renovate v36+ deprecation of matchCurrentVersion for non-semver patterns (resolves Config Migration Needed in Dependency Dashboard).
